# The Resurrection — Jesus Is Alive (Matthew 28:6)

## Emotional Focus
The greatest miracle — Jesus is alive and with us forever.

## Key KJV
“He is not here: for he is risen, as he said.” (Matthew 28:6)

## Gentle Retelling
After Jesus died, women came to the tomb on the third day. An angel said, “He is risen!” Jesus met them alive and full of love. He is alive today.

## Coloring Prompt
Empty tomb with the stone rolled away, soft sunrise, and women looking amazed and happy.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus conquered death. He is alive and loves you always.”
